description: This file contains a SwiftUI extension for ChannelsSettings, defining the user interface components such as sidebar, detail views, and associated UI elements for managing and displaying channels within a macOS application.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout of the ChannelsSettings extension, arranging sidebar and detail views with lifecycle event handlers.

methods.name: sidebar
methods.description: Constructs a scrollable sidebar listing configured and available channels.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: Displays detailed information about the selected channel or an empty placeholder.

methods.name: emptyDetail
methods.description: Provides a placeholder view when no channel is selected.

methods.name: channelDetail
methods.description: Constructs a scrollable view showing detailed information and settings for a specific channel.

methods.name: sidebarRow
methods.description: Creates a button row in the sidebar representing a channel, with visual indication if selected.

methods.name: sidebarSectionHeader
methods.description: Generates a section header label within the sidebar.

methods.name: detailHeader
methods.description: Builds the header section for a channel detail view, including title, status, and action controls.

methods.name: statusBadge
methods.description: Creates a styled badge to indicate the status of a channel.
